name: 500 Rummy
description: 500 Rummy: first to 500 points wins. Melds (sets and runs) score positive; unmelded cards in hand count negative. Key twist: you may draw any card from the discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately. 2-8 players; 52 cards plus 2 jokers.

overview.description: 500 Rummy: first to 500 points wins. Melds (sets and runs) score positive; unmelded cards in hand count negative. Key twist: you may draw any card from the discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately. 2-8 players; 52 cards plus 2 jokers.

history.origins: American rummy variant; first to 500 points wins. Key rule: may draw any card from discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately.
timeline: Early 20th century: 500 Rum emerged in the United States as a popular rummy variant and later inspired Canasta and related games.
history.cultural: USA; popular family and club game.

setup.dealing: Seven cards each (2 players) down to five (5+ players); rest stock; one discard pile.

rules.objective: First to 500 points wins. Melds (sets and runs) score positive; unmelded cards in hand count negative. You may take any card from the discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately.
rules.gameplay: Draw one from stock or take from discard (must take all above chosen card and meld that card). Lay melds; add to existing melds. Discard one. Go out by melding all; unmelded cards count negative. Jokers wild.
keyRules: Draw from stock or take from discard (take all above, meld the taken card)

strategy.basic: Take from discard when you can use the card and the pile helps; avoid leaving useful cards on top for opponents.
strategy.intermediate: Track discards; go out when you can to leave opponents with negative points.
strategy.advanced: Dump high unmelded cards early; time going out to maximise opponent penalty.
tips: Key twist: taking from discard requires taking all cards above your pick and melding the pick.
Jokers are wild; melds score positive, hand negative.

variations.name: Dealer's Gambit
variations.description: A 500 Rum variant that uses a special dealer's joker with nominated effects such as wild card, doubling a meld, or splitting the discard pile.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant rules are described in sources but engine overrides for dealer's joker effects are not yet modeled.

variations.name: Partnership 500 Rum
variations.description: Four-player partnership version where partners sit opposite, may play off on each other's melds, and scores are tracked and win at 500 as a team.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Partnership scoring and team play are noted in sources but specific engine overrides have not been added yet.

variations.name: Persian Rummy
variations.description: A higher-joker variant of 500 Rum using four jokers, where jokers form high-value melds of their own and scoring is adjusted across two deals.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Persian Rummy uses different joker counts and scoring; these mechanical differences are not yet encoded as engine overrides.
